podcast.body: This single, released in 1983, was a demonstration of the band's love for cycling and was well-received upon its release. It showcased their continued exploration of electronic sounds and themes, despite a looming five-year hiatus. "En 1983 lanzaron el single Tour de France, donde plasvaron su amor por el ciclismo, fue muy bien recibido."
